blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine sepak takraw team advanced to the gold medal match in women’s doubles of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 after outlasting Laos, 15-12, 15-10, in Monday’s semifinals. Team captain Abegail Sinogbuhan, Jean Marie Sucalit and substitute Nelly Jay Salon needed 43 minutes to repulse the Laotian and assure the country’s of at least a silver medal. Sinogbuhan, Sucalit and Salon will take on Vietnam for the ultimate prize in Tuesday’s final set at 8 a.m. Manila time. Vietnam eliminated South Korea, 15-6, 15-13, in the other semifinal […]...
